customPosts.title: SSC Advisory: Aadhaar Update & Biometric Unlock 2026
customPosts.shortInfo: SSC advised candidates to update Aadhaar demographics/biometrics and keep UIDAI biometrics permanently unlocked throughout exam duration.
customPosts.eligibility: All candidates appearing in Staff Selection Commission (SSC) examinations undergoing Aadhaar-based biometric verification.
howToApply: Ensure your Aadhaar demographic details (name, date of birth, address) and biometrics (fingerprints, iris scans, facial data) are updated well before your examination.

Select permanent biometric unlocking via UIDAI before arriving at the examination centre (temporary unlock lasts only 10 minutes and is insufficient for multi-tiered entry, in-exam, and exit verification).
You may re-lock your Aadhaar biometrics after successful completion of the examination.
documentsRequired: Updated Aadhaar details with permanently unlocked biometric status during exam hours
selectionProcess: Multi-tiered biometric verification at SSC examination centres covers entry, biometric authentication, in-exam verification, and exit procedures.

faq.question: Why does SSC advise against temporary UIDAI biometric unlock on exam day?
faq.answer: According to SSC Notice HQ-EDP08/7/2023-US EDP (e-6002) dated 17/11/2026, a temporary UIDAI unlock is valid for 10 minutes only, which is inadequate for multi-tiered verification covering entry, authentication, in-exam verification, and exit.

sourceHistory: Official SSC advisory DFA_notice_17112026.pdf (dated 17/11/2026) verified on 19/11/2026.

customPosts.title: SSC Grade 'C' Stenographers LDCE 2026 (320 Posts)
customPosts.department: DoPT / M/o Railways / AFHQ / MEA / ECI / CVC
customPosts.shortInfo: SSC issued Notice No. 4/12/2026-CONF-5 for Grade 'C' Stenographers LDCE 2026 (320 tentative posts); online forms open 17/11/2026 to 08/12/2026.
customPosts.eligibility: Regularly appointed Stenographer Grade 'D' in participating Services/Cadres (CSSS, RBSSS, AFHQ, IFS-B, ECI, CVC) fulfilling prescribed length of approved service (3 to 6 years by cadre as on 01/01/2026 or 01/07/2026) and computer literacy.
customPosts.totalPosts: 320 Tentative Posts (UR: 231, SC: 69, ST: 20; PwBD: 11 in CSSS)
howToApply: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC portal https://ssc.gov.in (old ssc.nic.in OTR is not functional).
Fill the online application form with live frontal photograph (no cap/glasses) and scanned JPEG signature (10–20 KB, 6.0 cm x 2.0 cm) by 08/12/2026 (23:00 hrs).
Upload certified copies of Service Book first page, particulars of service, and applicable PwBD / Skill Test exemption certificates.

Print the submitted application and have it forwarded through Head of Department / Cadre Controlling Authority to The Regional Director, SSC (Northern Region), Block No. 12, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003 by 22/12/2026 (18:00 hrs) — or 29/12/2026 (18:00 hrs) for abroad, A&N Islands, and Lakshadweep candidates.
documentsRequired: Certified true copy of first page of Service Book attested by HoD/Head of Office
Certified true copy of particulars of service attested by HoD/Head of Office (posts held, scale of pay, capacity)
Certificate of disability (Annexure-VII / VIII), if PwBD candidate
Stenography Skill Test exemption certificate, if applicable
Annexure-VI verification endorsement by Head of Department / Office for hard-copy forwarding
selectionProcess: Part-A: Computer Based Examination (200 Marks, 2 hours) — General Awareness (100 Qs / 100 Marks) and Comprehension & Knowledge of English Language (100 Qs / 100 Marks); negative marking 0.25 per wrong answer.
Part-B: Shorthand Skill Test in English or Hindi (200 Marks) — 10-minute dictation at 100 w.p.m., transcribed on computer (40 min English / 55 min Hindi; Mangal font mandatory for Hindi).
Part-C: Evaluation of Record of Service / APARs (100 Marks).

faq.question: What is the last date to apply for SSC Grade 'C' Stenographers LDCE 2026?

faq.question: Who is eligible to appear in this LDCE examination?
faq.answer: Only regularly appointed Stenographer Grade 'D' officials in the six participating Central Government Services/Cadres (CSSS, RBSSS, AFHQ, IFS-B, ECI, CVC) who meet the cadre-wise approved service period on the crucial date are eligible.
